checks.description: A harvester sent to a field less than one work cycle (60s) ago kept it instead of moving for the fleet's report, the haul limit, home ground coming back or a better score. Last fight had 59 switches of more than 8 cells within 45s of the previous one. Absent in a short win with no field changes is benign; absent in a loss with harvesters switching means the gate never ran.

A field choice went elsewhere because the field the whole fleet would otherwise have picked holds less than a load for each harvester already bound for it. Last fight seven harvesters were sent to a 665-credit patch at 535-549s. Unique prose literal from the crowdNote in HarvesterLogic.Decide.
Priority 1's per-harvester metric. Last fight 11.03 against the opponent's 16.3, and 7-9 across 480-600s while nine harvesters were alive; twelve prior 16:9 fights ran 8.2 to 13.1.

Frontier-to-home switches (haul limit, home ground back, fleet report toward home) fall, because commitment defers them and saturated home patches no longer count as home ground. Last fight 19; losses on record 17-44, wins 0-19.
Priority 1's headline metric. Last fight 25.9; every loss on record was 41 or less and every win 77 or more. Diagnostic: dominated by the match outcome.
Commitment keeps a recently switched harvester on a field the fleet reported for up to a minute. It must not cost more harvesters than the ping-pong did: 10 lost last fight, all of them.
No fight may run past the benchmark's 2,400s limit. A timed-out benchmark game voids its pair, and three voided pairs stop training.
